headline: Monaco's Lamine Camara says he has 'turned the page' after failed Chelsea move
description: Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara said he has moved on from his collapsed move to Chelsea and is fully focused on playing well for the Ligue 1 leaders.

headline: Tottenham's Roberto De Zerbi says Mykhailo Mudryk suffered 'stupid' injury
description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi has called new arrival Mykhailo Mudryk's injury "stupid" and has backed the winger to return to action soon.

headline: Arsenal reach agreement to sign 17-year-old winger Andria Bartishvili
description: Arsenal have agreed a pre-contract agreement to sign 17-year-old forward Andria Bartishvili.

headline: Xabi Alonso enjoys Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer's man of the match argument
description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso has said he believes the close friendship between Cole Palmer and summer signing Morgan Rogers is helping accelerate their blossoming on-field partnership.
